question:
**Direction: In the following sentence, four words are underlined, out of which one word is incorrectly spelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**

The __**sovenir** __shops within the __**amusement**__ parks do sell well because the **__visitors__** are mostly children and the shops keep a good stock of objects that children find **__fascinating__**.
solution:
Here, the erroneous word is **"sovenir.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of **"sovenir"** is **"souvenir."**
 
• **"Souvenir"** means a thing that is kept as a reminder of a person, place, or event. (स्‍मृति चिह्न, निशानी (कोई वस्‍तु जो किसी यात्रा-स्‍थल या छुट्टी या विशेष कार्यक्रम की याद दिलाती रहे))
 
 
• **Example:*** I brought back a menu as a **souvenir**__ of my trip.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is 'Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence: ***The __**souvenir**__ shops within the amusement parks do sell well because the visitors are mostly children and the shops keep a good stock of objects that children find fascinating.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'Amusement' **means the state or experience of finding something funny or entertaining.
 
• **'Visitors'** means a person who visits somebody/something
 
• **'Fascinating'** means extremely interesting or attractive while 'visitors' means people who visit a place.
